{{Top|leg}}
The '''Carbonite projector Mark II''' was an advanced model of the basic [[carbonite projector]], though it was equipped with more efficient projectors. This [[Droid/Legends|droid]] weapon used a [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbonite freezing]] technique to super-cool synthetic compounds hurled at a target. This item was considered unconventional and had not been in widespread use.

==Behind the scenes==
In game, a droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
